Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Bellaire for 2026, and here is what he found: 3 family events, 1 of them free. The magic runs from Wednesday, December 2 (Selfies with Santa) through Sunday, December 6 (Gingerbread Habitats at Nature Discovery Center), with Holiday in the Park (December 3) and the Nature Discovery Center Holiday Market (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Bellaire

  • 3 Christmas events for kids in Bellaire
  • 1 free event, Holiday in the Park, plus free admission to the Nature Discovery Center Holiday Market
  • Meet Santa: Selfies with Santa with cookie decorating at the Bellaire Civic Center on December 2, and his official arrival at Holiday in the Park on December 3
  • Snow, choirs and food on Bellaire Town Square at Holiday in the Park, December 3, 6 to 8:30 pm
  • Gingerbread Habitats for ages 3 to 8 at Nature Discovery Center, December 6, $25 members and $30 nonmembers
  • Season: December 2 to December 6

Planning a bigger day out? Bellaire families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Houston, which covers TXU Energy presents Zoo Lights, the Holiday Festival at Levy Park and Neighborhood Nights: Holiday Edition at Memorial Park.
